summary.headline: Planetary Combinations and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary combinations: Jupiter, Venus, and Moon signify practical, glorious, high-priestly, ambitious people with honors but unstable domestic relations; Venus, Sun, and Moon bring glory, blame, envy, advancement, and prosperity abroad; Venus, Mars, and Moon indicate unstable, magnanimous, wasteful, enterprising, wandering, and military qualities.
